---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a behaviour the library does not have yet
labels: enhancement
---

<!--
  The core is deliberately small and dependency-free, and every option added to
  it is an option that has to keep working on every device and every framework
  wrapper. Describing the problem first — rather than the API you have in mind —
  makes it much easier to tell whether it belongs in the core, in a wrapper, or
  in your own code on top of the instance the library already hands you.
-->

**The problem**
What are you trying to build, and where does the library get in the way today?

**What you tried**
The options, CSS custom properties, or instance methods you reached for, and how they fell short.

**The behaviour you want**
Describe it in terms of what the user of a page would see or feel.

**Which package**
`core`, `vue`, `react`, or all three.

**Anything that constrains it**
Reduced motion, touch devices, SSR, a framework's lifecycle — anything you already know this has to
survive.
